source: xraylib 4.3.0 (Scofield/EPDL97 photoionisation, Hubbell form factors; f1 from Kissel)
note: mu_loss = photoabsorption + incoherent (Compton) attenuation; beta = mu_loss lambda / 4 pi. Rayleigh is coherent and kept out of beta. Pair production is omitted (below 1.6 % of attenuation under 3 MeV).

C_diamond.role: densest low-Z solid: highest electron density per unit photoabsorption
